login.2fa.intro_verify: We have sent a code to {MAIL}. Please enter it below.

login.2fa.msg_wrong_code: The code is not correct or has expired.
login.2fa.msg_too_many: Too many wrong codes. Please log in again.
login.2fa.msg_expired: The login has expired. Please log in again.

login.2fa.btn_recovery_saved: I have saved the codes - continue
login.2fa.mail_body:
Hello {USERNAME},

your code for logging in to the backend:

{CODE}

The code is valid for {MINUTES} minutes. If you did not try to log in, someone knows your password - please change it.
account.2fa.title: Two-factor authentication
account.2fa.required: Required for all backend users on this site.
account.2fa.not_required: Not enabled on this site. You can set it up already - it is used as soon as it is enabled in data/config.php.
account.2fa.setup_intro: We send a code to {MAIL}. Enter it to finish the setup.
account.2fa.status: Method: e-mail ({MAIL}) · set up on {DATE} · recovery codes left: {COUNT}
account.2fa.confirm_intro: To change anything, confirm with your password and a code (sent by e-mail) or a recovery code.
account.2fa.confirm_disable: Disable two-factor authentication for your account?
account.2fa.msg_disabled: Two-factor authentication has been disabled for your account.
account.2fa.msg_new_recovery: New recovery codes have been created - the old ones no longer work.
account.2fa.recovery_intro: Keep these codes in a safe place - each one lets you log in once if you can not receive a code. They are only shown now.
users.2fa.reset_intro: If the user can not log in anymore (lost access to the e-mails and recovery codes), reset two-factor authentication. The setup starts again at the next login.
users.2fa.confirm_reset: Reset two-factor authentication for this user?
users.2fa.not_own: You can not reset your own two-factor authentication here - use your settings instead.

login.2fa.choose_method: Two-factor authentication is required for the backend. How do you want to get your codes?
login.2fa.method_mail_help: A new code is sent to {MAIL} for each login.

login.2fa.help_recovery_app: No access to the app? Enter one of your recovery codes instead.

account.2fa.confirm_intro_app: To change anything, confirm with your password and a code from your app or a recovery code.
account.2fa.confirm_reconfigure: Remove the current two-factor setup and set it up again?
